title: delegate this engineering task to AntiGravity: implement the …
objective:
delegate this engineering task to AntiGravity: implement the final autonomous self-healing control plane for Agentic OS. From now on, whenever a local action fails, verification fails, Jarvis makes a false success claim, or a capability is broken, do not ask me whether I want a repair. Automatically create a self-heal incident and delegate the repair to AntiGravity. Preserve the original GoalRun and original user command. AntiGravity must diagnose the real runtime failure, inspect and edit the AgenticOS repository, run tests, build, deploy the installed application, restart/reload the affected runtime, then retry the ORIGINAL failed command. Argus must independently verify the physical result before the original GoalRun is allowed to complete. If verification still fails, continue the same repair task rather than creating another unrelated task.
Give AntiGravity engineering access to the AgenticOS repo D:\AgenticOS, the installed AgenticOS runtime under C:\Users\cd-pr\AppData\Local\Programs\AgenticOS, AgenticOS logs/configuration under AppData, and the commands necessary for test/build/deploy/restart.
Jarvis must also speak lifecycle feedback to me:
1. “That action failed. I’m sending the repair to AntiGravity.”
2. Only after a real task ID, AntiGravity session ID and WORKER_ACCEPTED: “AntiGravity accepted the repair and is working on it.”
3. On meaningful stages: “It found the issue and is rebuilding/deploying/retrying.”
4. Only after the original command is retried and Argus verifies it: “The repair is complete and verified.”
Never say completed merely because a task was created, a command returned exit code 0, or a worker claims success.
Acceptance test: after implementation, deliberately use one currently failing command such as “Jarvis, open Word and create a blank document.” I must NOT say “delegate to AntiGravity.” Jarvis must detect the failure itself, automatically create the AntiGravity repair, repair the capability, deploy it, retry “open Word and create a blank document,” and Argus must verify that the Word document actually exists. Then repeat with “take a screenshot” and require a real saved screenshot artifact, not a byte-count claim.
Do not work on individual Word, Zeus, Comet, screenshot, Hermes, or voice bugs first. Build this universal automatic recovery path so those failures become inputs to the same self-healing system.

Relevant Context:
Requested over the JARVIS live conversation channel.
